column4: dialect-gated per SUBTEST: a registeredBackends test, so mysql and mssql skip in these PostgreSQL-only jobs while postgres RUNS -- two, not three. Measured by name with only CLEAT_TEST_POSTGRES set. This test exists BECAUSE cleat#1671 was covered behaviourally on PostgreSQL alone, with the other two dialects resting on a source-text guard that asserted the DELETE precedes the INSERT; cleat#1753 had to change that ordering on MySQL (an unconditional non-matching DELETE gap-locks under REPEATABLE READ and deadlocks every concurrent starter), so the proxy was relaxed per dialect and the property is now checked directly here instead. It has to run on all three for exactly that reason: the arms that skip in this job are the two that had no behavioural coverage at all.
